name: Operation First Light
summary: Hypothetical scenario: a small coalition team crosses the highlands to meet an invented resistance cell. The resistance leads. Together they protect Qanat Village, deliver aid and offer a ridge-road garrison the chance to surrender.

states.objective: Briefing: a resistance cell has asked for help protecting a village. Make contact, protect the people and let them lead.
Fly Raven over both approaches and mark the regime patrols.
Choose the approach. The ridge pass is fast but watched; the dry wadi is slow but hidden.
Take the team over the ridge pass and clear the patrol without alerting the village.
Move the team along the dry wadi. Watch for flash floods and patrol drones.
Meet the resistance cell at the safehouse. Listen first: they know the village and they lead.
Regime security squads are moving on Qanat Village. Protect the villagers and get them clear of the fighting.
Escort the aid convoy to the village so water, food and medical supplies reach the people.
The garrison on the ridge road is mostly conscripts. Offer them the chance to surrender before any assault.
Debrief: how many civilians were protected, how much aid arrived and how many soldiers laid down their arms.
The village is safe, the aid has arrived and the resistance trusts the coalition. The way inland is open.
The village held, but people were hurt or aid fell short. The resistance will keep working with the coalition, with less trust.
The operation failed: the village was lost or too many civilians were harmed. Restart from the last checkpoint.
